beats.title: pictures of Amy and Blaze over music

beats.text: So Scourge is against Sonic in the game? *walking with Amy*
*sigh* Yeah. I can tell Sonic has a frightful feeling
Since when is Sonic scared of Scourge? After teasing him all these years
Well since he almost killed me, Sally and Manic, he's evil
Has Sonic ever told you about Kindergarden?
Not really, why?
Well... Sonic and Scourge have known each other since Kindergarden, they were best friends
That's unbelievable!
That's what everyone says, but it's true.
So it all started when Sonic was getting bullied by the 6th graders
Apparantly, they teased him because he was the only hedgehog
What about Manic and Sonia?
They both were separated in other kindergardens
Sonic had to always run in the toilets to hide, but that's when things get worst
Oh!
Until one day, a new student came
Children, we have a new boy, let's welcome him to our kindergarden!
Everyone this is Scourge
Hi!
Hello!
I'm Sonic the Hedgehog!
!!! You're a hedgehog too?
You're an hedgehog?!
Yeah!
They both became best friends, they had fun together and even visited each other's house
They even had sleepovers, man they loved to tickle each other
So when did Scourge do something bad that made Sonic hate him?
Actually, Amy.. it wasn't Scourge who started the riot, it was Sonic
But.. how?
Well after a couple of years later, in grade 4 Sonic notices something about Scourge
that everytime Scourge comes over and sees Sonia. He always flirts around her
and that's because... he was in love with her
Sonic didn't understand love, so he got a little fishy
Why are you getting so close to my sister?!
I told you she's my girlfriend!
NO, SHE'S NOT!

beats.cap: *Sonic kicked him, punched him then grabbed him*
*he threatens Scourge to never go near Sonia again*

beats.text: SCOURGE! WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU'RE DOING TO MY BROTHER?!
HE DID IT BEFORE! HE EVEN THREATENED ME TO NEVER GO NEAR YOU AGAIN!
I DON'T CARE! YOU SHOULD NEVER HARM ANY OF MY BROTHERS, NOW GET OUT!
BUT SONIA, I WASN'T GONNA JUST SIT THERE AND GET-
I DON'T WANT TO SEE YOU AGAIN IN THIS HOUSE!
WE'RE OVER!
FINE! But just you wait, Sonic the Hedgehog.. I'LL GET MY REVENGE.. someday
And that's when it all started... Scourge's heart turns to dark.. and so has Sonic's.. but not until he met you
Now I understand.. why he wants me.. no wonder why he tried to kill me
So.. did I make this worst?
No, you made it much better. You finally showed Sonic what love is, if you never came.. Sonic and Scourge would've kept fighting
Trust me, Scourge's not gonna leave Sonic alone till he gets what he wants
and Sonic will protect you at all cost, because he loves you very much, Amy
